$comment: Optional developer tooling: MCP servers for an assistant working on THIS
repository. Nothing in the application reads this file, and contributing
does not require it -- see CONTRIBUTING.md.
Not to be confused with apps/mcp_server (the endpoint this application
exposes) or apps/mcp_client (the servers it calls out to). This file is
about the repository, not the product.
The Postgres entry points at the compose database and is READ-ONLY, which
is deliberate: an assistant that can read the schema answers most
questions, and one that can write to a developer's database can lose an
afternoon's fixtures without meaning to. Change it if you disagree, but
The credentials below are the local compose ones in docker-compose.yml.
They are not secret and they reach nothing outside your machine.
